headline: AICM Passenger Traffic Rose 1.7% Between January and October; International Flights Pick Up
summary: AICM handled 22.57 million passengers from January to October, with international passengers up 4.4% to 14.96 million. Total passenger growth was reported at 0.0% in the same release.
why: Mexico City's AICM is the country's main airport, and its passenger volumes indicate demand in air travel and tourism.
original_headline: AICM incrementó 1.7% los pasajeros atendidos entre enero y octubre; repuntan vuelos internacionales
